description: This file implements core logic for a filesystem I/O system, including expression parsing, evaluation, and handling of external tables and inputs. It appears central to managing and evaluating logical expressions in the firmware, particularly in a Reverse Polish notation context.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element in the expression, which can be a value, operator, or method.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Handles the evaluation of logical expressions in Reverse Polish notation, managing a stack-based calculation.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects to optimize allocation during parsing.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Associates operator/method names with their corresponding actions and registers them in a list.

methods.name: LENameOrdinalPair::LENameOrdinalPair
methods.description: Constructor that registers a name with an action in the linked list.

methods.name: LEElement::clear
methods.description: Resets the element to default state.

methods.name: LEElement::init
methods.description: Initializes the element with an action and optionally a value.

methods.name: LECalculator::add
methods.description: Adds an element to the evaluation list.

methods.name: LECalculator::pop
methods.description: Pops a value from the stack for a specific action.

methods.name: LECalculator::push
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the stack with an associated action.

methods.name: LECalculator::processElement
methods.description: Processes a single element in the expression for evaluation.

methods.name: LECalculator::getValue
methods.description: Computes and returns the value of the expression given a selfValue.

methods.name: LEElementPool::parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a string expression into a linked list of LEElements.
